pages.title: Memories on the Shelf
pages.text: Choose which pictures to display and which to keep together.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Look up Album and Photograph Frame for two ways to keep prints. Try adding a finished photograph; this goal records obtaining both items.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: The album stores in-world photographs; ordinary screenshots have a separate menu/hotkey viewer. Shulker tooltips preview contents without placing the box; preview keys may be remapped.
